reporting-org.narrative: Global Antibiotic Research and Development Partnership

description.narrative: Globally, infectious diseases such as pneumonia and sepsis are the leading cause of death and disability in children under five and are responsible for more than 3 million deaths a year. The situation is worsened by drug-resistant infections, as the limited number of treatments for children and babies are becoming less effective. More than 214,000 babies die each year from drug-resistant infections. Most of these deaths occur in low- and middle-countries.
